name: Dazed
flavor:
Light behind the eyes, left by a Grave Wisp.

Those who have seen a wisp up close say it looked at them as if reading.

Close your eyes. Do not speak your name until the light is gone.

name: Guilt
textTemplate: Unplayable. At the end of your turn, if this is in your hand, lose {loseHp} HP.
flavor:
What follows looting at the Second Cairn.

The second time is easier. That is how climbers know the ring has begun on them.

name: Slimed
flavor:
Grey muck from the drowned hamlet.

It clings, and will not wash out in cold water. The hamlet flooded before the Burning, in a flood the Wardens called natural.

It is warmer than anything in the weald has a right to be.

name: Wound
flavor:
A cut that closed wrong.

It knits into a hard ridge that aches before the weather turns. Climbers call it the road keeping its share.

The hamlets' older word for it means owed.
